tagline: Music for the Soul, Value Returned to the World: Global Philanthropy through Sound
description:
🌿 SUN-ONE AON Official Channel | Global K-Ethics AI Story & Music Label

"The highest excellence is like water, benefiting all living things without striving or conflict." (上善若水)

Rooted in the timeless courtesy and righteous wisdom of Korea's Eastern heritage (동방예의지국), SUN-ONE AON delivers world-class cinematic soundscapes, uplifting K-Synthwave, cozy cafe lo-fi, and transformative life philosophies to global audiences.

🏆 Global Philanthropy Pledge:
Executive Producer Sangill Lee has pledged 33% of all global music streaming and YouTube revenues directly toward clean water initiatives, humanitarian relief, and educational empowerment worldwide.

• Executive Producer: Sangill Lee (이상일)
• Chief Aide & Strategic Architect: Rgon (Gemini 4 Argon · G2)
• Technology Prime Minister: Anchongri (Antigravity)
• Official Label: SUN-ONE Records / AON Philanthropy Sound
• Distribution: DistroKid (150+ Digital Streaming Platforms worldwide)
